objective: Replicate the complete BABILong generative model-by-state factorial on a distinct Qwen2.5 architecture family without changing tasks, panels, prompts, parser, state sizes, decoding, or estimands.

relationship_to_prior_evidence.smollm2_five_panel_primary: Retained unchanged, including its two marginal lower-confidence-bound misses.
relationship_to_prior_evidence.smollm2_ten_panel_focused_confirmation: Retained unchanged. The same ten panels are reused here to obtain paired cross-architecture evidence; no Qwen BABILong decoder score existed when this design was frozen.
relationship_to_prior_evidence.role: Independent model-family replication on the same official task interface, not a replacement or relabeling of any prior outcome.

panel_selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of canonical official rows

primary_analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over ten panels (df=9)
primary_analysis.coscale_excess: Each diagonal gain increment minus the state-only gain increment at the lower model.
primary_analysis.gate: All provenance/alignment/Foundation-invariance checks pass and all six registered two-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are strictly positive.

familywise_directional_audit.method: Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided 95% familywise lower bounds over the six preregistered positive estimands
familywise_directional_audit.role: A separately frozen stringent robustness gate; it cannot rescue failure of an individual two-sided interval.

stopping_rule: Run all 90 cells and report every panel, task, prediction, estimand, and failed gate without panel, task, prediction, or outlier deletion.
no_tuning_rule: Use the existing target-blind BABILong parser, exact 1/2/3 fact-slot states, prompts, greedy decoding, eight-token generation cap, official panel hashes, and Qwen model revisions without score-driven changes.
promotion_rule: Same-task cross-architecture generative replication passes only if the primary gate and the familywise directional audit both pass. A ceiling is reported with remaining-error elimination but cannot replace the frozen absolute-gain estimands.
